entities.name: rs2444043
observations: Common RAB27A variant associated with adult fractional exhaled nitric oxide in European-ancestry cohorts; combined adult discovery and replication P=1.6×10⁻⁷. Effect direction unavailable in retrieved abstract.
Association was not observed for childhood FeNO in EAGLE (n=8,858).

entities.name: RAB27A adult FeNO association
observations: Adult study cohorts: EGEA n=610 and Hutterites n=601; adult Talana replication n=450. Combined adult result for rs2444043 reached P=1.6×10⁻⁷; effect direction is unspecified.
